title: "Cause" is Mechanistic Narrative within Scientific Domains: An Ordinary Language Philosophical Critique of "Causal Machine Learning"
abstract: arXiv:2501.05844v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Causal Learning has emerged as a major theme of research in statistics and machine learning in recent years, promising computational techniques to reveal ``true'' causality. In this paper, we critique the premise of causal learning by considering the epistemology of causality across disciplines, applying the Ordinary Language method of an anthropological investigation of customary word use in reasoning about cause and effect in the real world. We observe that although cause-and-effect semantics vary between scientific domains, they maintain a consistent central function of describing the mechanisms underlying forces most salient to the systems under research. translated_title: “原因”是科学领域内的机制性叙述：对“因果机器学习”的日常语言哲学批判
translated_abstract: 因果学习近年来已成为统计学和机器学习研究的主要主题，承诺通过计算技术揭示“真正的”因果关系。本文通过考虑跨学科因果性的认识论，运用日常语言方法对人类在现实世界中推理因果关系的习惯用词进行人类学调查，从而批判因果学习的前提。我们观察到，尽管因果语义在不同科学领域间有所差异，但它们保持了一致的核心功能，即描述对所研究系统中最显著力量起作用的机制。一个关键区别在于，用于统计分析的模型数学表示与专家在机制方面的知识之间，在多大程度上存在忠实的对应关系。我们将1）物理学和工程学划分为数学模型充分对应机制知识的领域，而2）其他领域（如社会科学或生物学）则存在不同程度的对应不足，这导致因果学习在这些领域的适用性和解释力受到限制。
tldr: 本文通过日常语言哲学视角批判因果机器学习，指出因果关系本质上是各科学领域内的机制性叙述，其有效性取决于数学模型与专家机制知识的对应程度。
en_tdlr: This paper critiques causal machine learning through ordinary language philosophy, arguing that causality is a mechanistic narrative within scientific domains, whose validity depends on the correspondence between mathematical models and expert mechanistic knowledge.
